text: So heres the deal, I would say I'm not a Type of person that will post 1 star Reviews but I have to now because of the poor Service, approximately almost 9:35pm I went up to McDonalds so I can get me some food before work, ordered up a Chicken Wrap and Large fries, heres whats going on, I get the food (And usually the food is Completely cooked fresh), the problem that we had here was the food was cold on both the fries and the Wrap, I told the employee what was going on, he had a Attitude and told me thats how the wrap was suppose to be, I then replied uhm no, any time I get the wraps or the burgers its always cooked fresh, dont understand why its cold, he replied with we warm them up. Right, so since when is that a thing?, he got confrontational with me verbally and I asked hey let me speak with your manager. He then said you can speak with both of them. I said I wanna talk with the one in the Navy Blue Uniform, so the manager asked me what was going on and I told him fries were cold and the wrap was also cold. There both supposed to be cooked EVERY time. He said would remake it, it'll take 6 minutes, okay not a problem, second round the wrap was Still cold so I said okay now I need a refund at this point because im not gonna sit there and ask them to re make it the manager asked me do you not want it and i said nope because its cold again, also, additionally, why the hell are all of the workers not using Gloves while theyre Making Guests Food, its a Health code violation.
author: Kevin J. Massey

text:
First, let me say that I am a McDonald's fan. I go to McDonald's regularly and enjoy the consistent food.

This is the worst McDonald's I've ever been to. Note the picture. There are no staff behind the counter. All the orders are by kiosk now and the menus have been shut off. The drinks were all pre-poured. By the time we got ours, the ice had completely melted.

The time printed on my order slip was 12:52.  It was 1:12 by the time my order was called. And they were not very busy. 20 minutes of waiting for "fast" food is not acceptable. The first drink I got had all the ice melted and I returned it. The second was diet Coke and I had ordered Coke. The third was Dr. Pepper, and I had ordered a Coke. So I had to return three drinks to get two. The fries were barely warm and the Big Mac spent too much time in the bin.

This place has horrible service and terrible quality of food. Many customers were irate. I recommend you avoid this place.
author: Mike Reaves

text: If I could give 0 stars to this place I would, I understand that there are people who do not like their work, that there are things that the system does that are not the fault of the employees either. But the thing starts when you try to be kind and understandable with the situation, the 3 or 4 employees of the night shift are deplorable, they throw you things (menus, food bags), they do everything wrong, drinks, hamburgers, desserts. They should fire everyone because people are only looking for something simple like a hamburger or a drink after a long night of fun, but if even when you try to be a good person they treat you badly, everyone should leave because they put this place on a very bad reputation.
author: Santiago Rafael

text:
You don’t expect a fancy burger when you go to McDonald’s but you do expect a cleanish place to sit and not fried all over the floor! This place was really bad!

My recent visit to McDonald's was disappointing. The food quality has noticeably declined, with items appearing hastily prepared and lacking freshness. The service was slow, and the staff seemed indifferent to customer satisfaction. The overall cleanliness of the restaurant left much to be desired, and the dining area was unkempt. It's unfortunate to see a decline in the standards that used to make McDonald's a reliable fast-food option. I hope they address these issues for a better customer experience in the future.
author: Maya Shb

text: The fact that the elevator has fallen into the state of disrepair that it has fallen into is TOTALLY UNACCEPTABLE!!! The panel is FALLING OUT AND ONLY BEING HELD ON BY A SINGLE ROPE!!! It makes it almost impossible to push the buttons! Plus, with all the wiring exposed, someone could get ELECTROCUTED!!! Unbelievable! By not maintaining their elevator properly, that constitutes a VIOLATION OF THE LAW!!! To sum it up, DON'T EVER COME HERE!!! Go to a different McDonald's location in Vegas if you want a Big Mac.
author: Dante Medori

text:
